components.name: Letter Tile
components.description: Bevelled wooden letter tile with score subscript.
components.css: .ds-tile { --s: 64px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--s); height: var(--s); border-radius: calc(var(--s) * 0.15); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), rgba(255,255,255,0) 46%), #9b4a27; color: #f7ecd3; font: 700 calc(var(--s) * 0.6)/1 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 calc(var(--s) * 0.03) 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.45), inset 0 calc(var(--s) * -0.05) 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 calc(var(--s) * 0.12) calc(var(--s) * 0.14) calc(var(--s) * -0.06) rgba(74,42,22,0.5), 0 1px 2px rgba(74,42,22,0.3); } .ds-tile i { position: absolute; right: 11%; bottom: 8%; font: 600 calc(var(--s) * 0.2)/1 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Blank-Tile Button
components.description: The primary action, a red blank tile.
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 22px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), rgba(255,255,255,0) 46%), #b83a24; color: #f7ecd3; font: 600 1rem/1 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 6px 10px -4px rgba(74,42,22,0.55); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); filter: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2e1d14; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tool Tile
components.description: Cream tool tile for theme and sound; same in both themes.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; background: #efe0bd; color: #2e1d14; font: 600 0.875rem/1 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.14), 0 6px 10px -4px rgba(74,42,22,0.5); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.15s; } .ds-tool:hover { background: #f6ebd0; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-tool:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c4432c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Word Card
components.description: Cleared word spelled in tiles with class and definition; sits in the left column beside the board on wide windows (300px, top aligned), centred on the board at 1080px and narrower. Shown only for words with a definition.
components.html:
SOL

sustantivo

Estrella alrededor de la cual gira la Tierra.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 12px 14px 14px; background: #f8f0dc; border: 1px solid #d2c29d; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(74,42,22,0.35); color: #2e1d14; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 240px; } .ds-word { display: flex; gap: 3px; } .ds-t { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; border-radius: 5px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), rgba(255,255,255,0) 46%), #dfc79a; color: #2e1d14; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 2px 3px rgba(74,42,22,0.3); } .ds-kind { margin: 10px 0 2px; color: #6f5646; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-def { margin: 0; color: #4a362a; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Score Panel
components.description: Side-column panel of label and value rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { margin: 0; padding: 4px 16px; background: #f8f0dc; border: 1px solid #d2c29d; border-radius: 12px; color: #2e1d14; font-family: 'Jost Variable', 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; width: 280px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid rgba(74,42,22,0.12); } .ds-panel dt { color: #6f5646; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Board Tile (canvas)
components.description: Canvas tile drawn in app.ts: palette from --t0..--t6, top sheen, darker bottom edge, 1px hairline edge (shadow-rgb at .3) when settled; falling piece has an ink outline (--hot-outline) and a bigger shadow; letter Jost 700 at 0.6 of the side.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.24), rgba(255,255,255,0) 46%), #efe0bd; color: #2e1d14; font: 700 29px/1 'Jost Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 0 0 1px rgba(74,42,22,0.3), 0 4px 7px rgba(74,42,22,0.4); }

narrative.overview:
One world: a warm cream tabletop with bevelled wooden letter tiles in the manner of a Scrabble specimen poster, recreated under its own title. Everything that moves or can be read is either a tile or sits on the table beside one. The cover spells VERBUM TETRIS as a crossword of tiles that settle in one by one; the game then reuses the same tile as the falling piece, the cleared-word card and the phone notice.

Density is calm. The board is the one large object, with a single narrow side panel; nothing competes with the tiles. Colour comes from the tiles and one red action; the table itself is neutral and warm, never white or black.

Two themes share the world. Light is the cream table. Dark is the same table at night: only ground, panels, text and shadows change; the tiles keep their colours and inks.
keyCharacteristics: Bevelled tiles: top highlight, bottom inner edge, soft contact shadow.
Seven earth tile colours, each paired with its own ink.
One geometric sans (Jost Variable) at weights 600 to 700.
Cream tool tiles identical in both themes.

rules.name: The Same Tiles Rule
rules.body: Theme switches change ground, panels, text and shadows only. Tile colours and inks never change between light and dark.

rules.name: The Paired Ink Rule
rules.body: Every tile colour travels with its ink token (--tN and --tN-ink); contrast is decided once, there.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the blank-tile action. It is not used for tiles, errors or decoration.

rules.name: The Tile Letter Rule
rules.body: Letters on tiles are bold (700) and uppercase; everything else stays weight 400 to 650.

rules.name: The Lying-Flat Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and offset downward with negative spread; no hard offset shadows, no glow.

dos: Do build every new surface from tiles on the cream table; take letters, colours and inks from the seven tile pairs.
Do keep tool tiles the same in both themes and the tile colours the same in both themes.
Do use Jost Variable only, bold on tiles.
Do give interactive tiles a visible 3px focus outline and a reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't re-tune the cover tile look (bevel, gradient, radius, shadow) without the owner; they approved it.
Don't add a second accent next to Blank-Tile Red or colour tiles outside the seven.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glows, pure white or pure black grounds, or a second typeface.
